# Stefano Bonini

> Italian economist and risk advisor specialising in credit risk and FinTech. Adjunct Professor at the University of Bologna and the University of Florence; Partner and Head of Risk Advisory at MBS Consulting (ION Group). ORCID: 0000-0002-9063-866X.

## About
- Teaches FinTech (University of Bologna), Innovation in Banking and Financial Markets (University of Florence), Financial Risk Management (LUMSA University, Rome), Credit Risk (POLIMI Graduate School of Management, Milan)
- Formerly head of the Credit Risk & Risk Governance practice at Accenture; earlier at Deloitte Consulting and Prometeia
- Research: PD/LGD modelling, survival analysis in the Basel framework, climate risk in IRB models, machine learning in credit risk, FinTech
- PhD in Banking & Finance (cum laude), University of Rome Tor Vergata; CStat (Royal Statistical Society), PStat (American Statistical Association)

## Books
- [FinTech: Rethinking Financial Intermediation. Innovation, Markets, and Regulation](https://www.francoangeli.it/Libro/FinTech:-Rethinking-Financial-Intermediation?Id=30825): with Giuliana Caivano, FrancoAngeli, 2026, ISBN 9788835196099
- [Statistica per le decisioni economiche e finanziarie](https://francoangeli.it/Libro/Statistica-per-le-decisioni-economiche-e-finanziarie?Id=30509): with Giuliana Caivano, FrancoAngeli, 2026, ISBN 9788835187905
